# 19 Fix the actor label printing through the stick figure

## Outcome

An `actor` lane's label sits clear of its stick-figure icon instead of being drawn across the
figure's legs, in both the top and bottom participant rows, and the row still fits inside the
height `layoutSequence` reserves for it.

## Why this ticket exists

Found by rasterizing `examples/sequence-core.srn` with the shipped theme applied and looking at
it: the actor `User`'s label is drawn at the icon's vertical centre-bottom, so the text and the
figure's two legs occupy the same pixels. A `participant` lane is unaffected — its label is
centred inside a box that is drawn to contain it. Reported independently by the ticket-18 worker
and confirmed visually by the orchestrator before this ticket was written.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] An `actor` lane's label does not overlap its stick-figure strokes: the label's baseline
  sits below the lowest point of the icon (or the icon is drawn to leave the label's band free —
  either is acceptable as long as they no longer intersect).
- [ ] The actor icon and its label together stay inside the participant row's reserved band, so
  the row does not spill into the message area the way ticket 17 just fixed for the box row.
- [ ] The bottom actor row is fixed the same way as the top one.
- [ ] A `participant` lane's label geometry is unchanged.
- [ ] The fix is verified by looking at a rendered image, not only by assertion — say in the
  report what you actually saw.

## Test seam

`renderSequenceToSVG(diagram): SVGSVGElement` (component, jsdom) for the element geometry, and
`layoutSequence(model, options)` if the row's reserved height needs to grow. jsdom does not
paint, so assert on coordinates (label baseline vs. the lowest icon stroke's `y`), and confirm
visually.
